map.name: Middle East
map.mapSpecificRules:
Only coal and oil can be bought for $1, and any number of oil can restock at $1.
During step 1, garbage and uranium plants will be removed from the current market.
Step 2 will be triggered after going through the deck once rather than by a specific number of cities.
Step 3 will be triggered after going through the deck a second time.
